name: Shaking Things Up

text.fail: Every player still in the colony must pass one of their survivors to the player on their left, and morale drops by 1.
text.bonus: Two cards beyond the need lift morale by 1.

notes: Official name Shaking Things Up (was our Reorganization). Tool symbol, each non-exiled player gives one survivor they control to the player on their left, lose 1 morale. The hook picks the survivor for the player (printed card lets the player choose). Id and hook name kept for saves.
